title: The Copycat Giveaway
intro: A creator you follow seems to be giving away phones. The message came straight to your inbox.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: You won a phone! Claim it now…

banner.text: New message request · you do not follow this account

screen.context: You follow a creator called Kiko, whose real account is @kiko.

msg.text: Claim in 2 hours or we pick someone else.

dmfirst.label: They messaged first
dmfirst.lens: A request from an account you do not follow.
dmfirst.why: Real creators announce winners in public posts, not by random DMs.

tick.label: Fake tick
tick.lens: The ✔ is typed into the name. A real badge sits next to the handle, and there is none.
tick.why: Anyone can type a tick into a display name.

handle.label: A copy of the real account
handle.lens: @kiko_official_giveaway is new. The real account is @kiko.
handle.why: Copy accounts add words to a real name. Check the real handle.

link.label: Look-alike link
link.lens: kiko-phones-claim.live is not a place a creator would use.
link.why: Never claim a prize through a link a stranger sends.

fee.label: Pay to receive a "free" phone
fee.why: A free prize that costs money is the scam.

deadline.label: Two-hour deadline
deadline.lens: Claim in 2 hours or lose it.
deadline.why: Pressure is a trick to stop you checking.

actions.label: Open the link and pay the €5
Look at the creator's real page

trap.title: Kiko Phones · Claim
trap.ask: Pay €5 delivery and enter your card number to receive your phone.

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. The copy account was removed before it reached more fans.

verify.line: The creator's real page had no giveaway, and a pinned warning about copy accounts. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The €5 page copied your card details. No phone came, and more charges followed.

what_if.go_ahead: Checking the real page first would have shown a warning about copy accounts.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A free prize that asks you to pay is not free. Check the creator's real page, not the DM.

quick_check.q: A DM says you won a free phone, but you must pay €5 for delivery. The account looks like a creator you follow. What do you do?

options.text: Reply to ask if it is real
Check the creator's real page, then block and report the copy
Ask the account to prove itself

quick_check.explain: A prize that asks for money is the trap. Check the real page.

hints.nudge: Does the real creator's page say anything about this?

rows.v: None. The ✔ is typed into the name
